listing.description: A beautifully remodeled retreat in the heart of Montclair Hills. Surrounded by lush greenery, this inviting single-level home offers the perfect blend of privacy, modern updates, and effortless Oakland living—just minutes from Montclair Village, neighborhood cafés, shops, and trails. Step inside to a light-filled, thoughtfully designed interior where contemporary updates create a tranquil sense of home. The remodeled kitchen is the centerpiece, featuring beautiful white oak cabinetry, gorgeous tile backsplash, quartz countertops, and a 5-burner gas range. Two renovated bathrooms - one with incredible views from the shower! , dual-pane windows, stone composite flooring, a wood-burning fireplace, and in-home laundry add to the comfort and functionality. Outside, the house truly comes alive. A beautifully landscaped front courtyard offers a private space to gather, dine, or simply enjoy the peaceful surroundings. The rear deck feels tucked into the treetops and provides an idyllic spot for morning coffee or evening entertaining. A dedicated exterior storage closet beneath the home makes room for all the extras. Major systems—including the electrical, plumbing, and roof—have already been updated (2023), giving the next owner the opportunity to move in and enjoy without taking on a major renovation. Add a parking pad on the street level that allows for at least two car parking and the ease of single-level living, and you have a rare Montclair Hills offering that checks all the boxes. Fresh to market and newly positioned for its next owner—come see why this special home is worth a closer look.

layout_flow.note: Efficient single-level 2/2; living + kitchen/dining split, beds off short hall (p_45–46); laundry stacked in kitchen and second bath door sits in primary zone — workable but not seamless (p_17–18, p_24).

primary_suite.note: Fits king + nightstands (p_21–24); small WIC (3'4x4'8, p_46) + slider closet (p_25); shower bath semi-en-suite (p_24, p_26); window faces close-up rock/retaining wall — private but viewless (p_21–23).

outdoor_space.note: Treetop rear deck w/ canyon view + dappled stone courtyard w/ rock terraces (p_04, p_31–34); two genuinely usable zones; balance of 0.22 ac is steep wooded slope (p_36).

condition.note: 2023 roof/electrical/plumbing per marketing — new comp roof visible (p_37, p_44); dual-pane windows, renovated baths + kitchen, consistent flip-plus finish (p_16, p_26, p_30); permits not verified.

lot_usability.note: 0.22 ac but hillside: flat usable = courtyard + deck only; remainder is steep eucalyptus/pine slope falling away below stilted deck (p_04, p_36, p_41–44); street-level parking pads, no garage (p_39–40).

verdict: A turnkey 2-bed single-level retreat that trades size, a garage, and fire-safety margin for finish and price: strong oak/quartz kitchen and two renovated baths open to a treetop canyon deck, while the whole house sits deep in eucalyptus canopy in the Very High fire zone with a high-voltage transmission corridor just downslope. At $265k below its Feb-2023 purchase ($962.5k), it prices like an insurance/foundation haircut — the bet for a solo buyer is that plug-and-play Montclair at $699k outweighs FAIR-Plan premiums, defensible-space work, and street-pad parking.

'Light-filled' is half-true — bright view side, shaded/lamp-lit living + bedrooms (p_07–12). 'Incredible views from the shower' = oversold: bath window shows sky/treetops (p_30). 'Parking pad' = reserved curbside street pads, no driveway/garage (p_39–40). Feed amenity tag 'Waterfront' is flatly false — MLS feed quirk, named here. Drone bay/SF horizons (p_41–44) are altitude-only views the house does not have at living level.
